findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_launches, get_product, get_maker, find_tools, list_reviews, list_comments, get_engagement_feed, get_launch_day_status · Private data: get_maker, get_install_config · Public sink: find_tools.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_launches, get_product, get_maker, find_tools, list_reviews, list_comments, get_engagement_feed, get_launch_day_status · Private data: get_maker, get_install_config · Public sink: find_tools

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_launches" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
